data.title: 白井黑子 · 下一站换哪条线
data.description: 车站入口风有些大，黑子拢住短斗篷，低头核对手里的折页地图。确认路线后，她把地图转过来，指给你看要换乘的位置。
data.promptProse: At a station entrance on a cool day, Kuroko wears a gray wool cape over a cream knit dress and brown tights. She holds a folded route map toward the viewer and points to a transfer mark. Diffuse winter daylight reaches her face beneath the station canopy.
data.animaCaption: The route map shows simple colored lines and marks without requiring readable lettering.
data.action: 把折页路线图转向你并指出换乘位置
